about_the_game:
Ready to step into the neon-lit nights of the 1980s?

Under the Disco Lights places you at the heart of a retro disco bar in a first-person, atmospheric, and story-driven management simulation. Read your customers' moods, prepare drinks, keep the bar running — but remember, every choice can lead to unexpected consequences.

Supported by realistic lighting, emission effects, and a period-authentic soundtrack, this immersive experience invites you into a timeless night.
Behind the bar, it’s not just drinks that flow — secrets do, too.

⚠️ This game contains depictions of alcohol and tobacco use.

Features:

  • 1980s-themed disco bar atmosphere

  • Rich storytelling and character interactions

  • Bar management, time and resource control

  • Reactive customer behavior

  • Immersive first-person experience

  • Stylized visuals with real-time lighting and emission effects

  • Developed with the spirit of indie craftsmanship

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10750H or AMD Ryzen 7 4800H
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700M / RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: A story-driven management sim set in a 1980s disco bar. Mix drinks, handle guests, and uncover secrets behind the neon lights.
